abilities.name: name
abilities.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

abilities.name: mark
abilities.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

abilities.name: tell
abilities.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

abilities.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.
